title: Durgapujo Dandiya & Diwali Festival 2026 In Cupertino
description: Immerse in Cultural Revelry at Durgapujo Dandiya & Diwali Festival 2026
long_description:
Immerse in Cultural Revelry at Durgapujo Dandiya & Diwali Festival 2026
Join us on the 16th of October, 2026 for a night of vibrant colors and rhythmic beats as we celebrate the Durgapujo Dandiya & Diwali Festival 2026 in Cupertino. Organized by WomenNow TV, this unique event combines the joyous festivities of Durga Pujo, Dandiya, and Diwali into one grand celebration. Experience an enchanting evening filled with fusion dance performances, multilingual music, and scrumptious food and drinks. Whether you're a fan of Hindi or Bengali culture or simply love the energy of Navratri/Dandiya and Diwali, this event is sure to delight you.
A Night of Thrilling Performances
Although the artist for this event is yet to be announced, be assured that the stage will be graced by talented performers who will add a touch of magic to the night. The performers will showcase a fusion of Hindi, Bengali, and other multilingual performances, making it a memorable night for all attendees.
Experience the Festivity at Monta Vista High School
The Durgapujo Dandiya & Diwali Festival 2026 will take place at the iconic Monta Vista High School located at 21840 McClellan Rd, Cupertino, CA, United States. Known for its safe and accessible location, the venue also offers ample parking space for attendees. After the event, you can explore some of the nearby Indian restaurants to satiate your food cravings.
Secure Your Tickets Now!
The event offers a variety of ticket options to cater to different preferences. The Dandiya Early Bird Pass for October 16, 2026, from 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM, lets you enjoy an exciting evening of Dandiya, Garba & Bollywood music with free parking and a dedicated kids' play area. Children below 5 enter free. There are day passes for October 17 and 18 with access to Saptami & Ashtami Pujo, Parama Awards & DJ Night, and more. Royal Bhog Lunch and Sindoor Thali are also available, making it a complete cultural and culinary experience. So, secure your tickets now and immerse yourself in an unforgettable celebration of culture and tradition.
